ValidationRule.description: A matter can only be opened once the conflict check is cleared or not required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Open'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'On Hold')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Conflict_Check_Status__c, 'Cleared')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Conflict_Check_Status__c, 'Not Required')))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Clear the conflict check (or mark it Not Required) before opening this matter.
